description: NFT Tagging - Allow users to organize NFTs into custom tags with cloud sync for cross-device persistence

userStories.title: Create tag API endpoints
userStories.description: As a developer, I need backend endpoints to persist tags so they sync across devices.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/user/tags creates a new tag (name, color) and returns the tag with generated ID
GET /api/user/tags returns all tags for the authenticated user
PUT /api/user/tags/:id updates a tag's name or color
DELETE /api/user/tags/:id deletes a tag and all its NFT associations
Tag name max 30 chars, must be unique per user (case-insensitive)
Maximum 20 tags per user enforced on create
Store tags in User Durable Object
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create NFT-tag association API endpoints
userStories.description: As a developer, I need endpoints to manage which NFTs belong to which tags.
acceptanceCriteria: PUT /api/user/tags/:id/nfts accepts { add: string[], remove: string[] } to bulk update associations
GET /api/user/tags/:id/nfts returns all NFT mints associated with a tag
GET /api/user/nft-tags returns a map of { [mint]: tagId[] } for all user's NFTs
Store nftTags as Record<string, string[]> in User Durable Object
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Sync tags on app load
userStories.description: As a user, I want my tags to load when I open the app.
acceptanceCriteria: On authenticated app load, fetch tags from GET /api/user/tags
Fetch nft-tag associations from GET /api/user/nft-tags
Store in Jotai atoms (tagsAtom, nftTagsAtom) for reactive updates
Handle loading state gracefully (don't flash empty tags)
Handle unauthenticated users (skip fetch, atoms remain empty)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Create tag management dialog
userStories.description: As a user, I want to create and manage my tags so I can organize my NFTs.
acceptanceCriteria: Create TagManagementDialog component in apps/web/src/components/
Dialog shows list of existing tags with name, color indicator, and NFT count
New Tag button opens inline form with name input and color picker
Color picker shows 8 preset colors: #ef4444, #f97316, #eab308, #22c55e, #06b6d4, #3b82f6, #8b5cf6, #ec4899
Each tag row has edit (pencil icon) and delete (trash icon) buttons
Delete shows confirmation dialog before removing tag
Calls appropriate API endpoints (POST for create, PUT for update, DELETE for delete)
Optimistic UI updates with rollback on API failure
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Add tags section to sidebar
userStories.description: As a user, I want to navigate to a tag to see all NFTs in it.
acceptanceCriteria: Tags section in sidebar below existing navigation items
Shows list of user's tags with color dot indicator and name
Clicking a tag navigates to /tags/:id route
Manage Tags link at bottom opens TagManagementDialog
Show 'No tags yet' message with create prompt if user has no tags
Section only visible when user is authenticated
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Add tag button to toolbar
userStories.description: As a user, I want to quickly tag selected NFTs from the toolbar.
acceptanceCriteria: Tag button appears in toolbar when NFTs are selected (next to Send, Burn, etc.)
Button shows Tag icon from lucide-react
Clicking opens a DropdownMenu with list of tags
Each tag shows checkbox indicating if ALL selected NFTs have that tag
Each tag shows count of NFTs in that tag (e.g. 'PFPs (12)')
Checking a tag calls PUT /api/user/tags/:id/nfts with { add: selectedMints }
Unchecking a tag calls PUT /api/user/tags/:id/nfts with { remove: selectedMints }
New Tag option at bottom opens TagManagementDialog
Optimistic UI updates
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Display tags on NFT cards
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see which tags an NFT belongs to at a glance.
acceptanceCriteria: NFT cards show small colored dots (4-6px diameter) in top-right corner for assigned tags
Maximum 3 dots displayed
Hovering dots shows tooltip with tag names
If more than 3 tags, show '+N' indicator after the 3 dots
Tags visible in all grid sizes (small, medium, large)
Read tag colors from tagsAtom, nft assignments from nftTagsAtom
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Create tag detail page

Create TagPage component that uses CollectionView
Filter nftsAtom to only NFTs where nftTagsAtom[mint] includes the tag ID
Page title shows tag name with color indicator dot
Empty state shows 'No NFTs in this tag' with prompt to add some
All standard grid features work (selection, bulk actions, sorting)
Pass tag-specific context (e.g. 'tag-{id}') to collage layout storage
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Add tag filter to main views

userStories.title: Add tag management to NFT detail modal
userStories.description: As a user, I want to manage tags for a single NFT from its detail view.

Lists current tags as removable chips with X button
